body.label: Trigger
body.html: An ally adjacent to another ally is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The target gains +1 Defense. One adjacent ally may also shift 1 unit to remain adjacent after the Action resolves.

surges.html: Increase a Defense bonus granted by this Reaction by 1.
One affected ally may ignore the next die it would burn before its next turn.
